CompBio & MIRaS is a multi-omic analysis platform.  CompBio multi-omic analysis platform is built upon Memory-based Intelligent Reasoning System (MIRaS), an associative reasoning engine grounded in episodic and semantic memory, capable of inferring biological relationships directly from stored knowledge rather than from model training. 

Paper:
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13501141/#SEC9

https://gtac-compbio-ex.wustl.edu/login
